Synthesia | London, Zurich, Munich | REMOTE (DE/UK/CH/ES/IE/SI/DK/CZ/BE)

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, HQ'd in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

Series E - backed by Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital.

We're hiring across:

Applied Research – pushing the frontier on video generation, avatars, voice and multimodal models | ONSITE (London/Zurich/Munich)

Software Engineering – full-stack, platform, infra, ML engineering | ONSITE (London/Zurich/Munich) or REMOTE (DE/UK/CH/ES/IE/SI/DK/CZ/BE)

Product Management – senior through to principal-levels, owning core product areas from creation to analytics, API, or distribution surfaces | ONSITE (London and Seattle for API-only) or REMOTE (DE/UK/CH/ES/IE/SI/DK/CZ/BE)

Product Design – shaping how humans interact and create AI video at scale | ONSITE (London) or REMOTE (DE/UK/CH/ES/IE/SI/DK/CZ/BE)

More details at: https://www.synthesia.io/careers#open-positions
